thread:
Maya (CS): quick heads-up — we just rolled back a config change to a Dedicated GPU pool which temporarily reduced throughput for ~8 onboarding accounts. drafting a short customer update below, pls chime in with fixes / credits.

Devon (Eng): Thanks — root cause: an autoscaler flag flip that increased spot eviction susceptibility, causing worker churn. rollback happened at 08:10 UTC; full stabilization by 08:22 UTC.

Luis (Support): Observed 502/timeout spikes during that window, tickets opened: #CS-7542, #CS-7547. affected customers on onboarding plan + 2 trial accounts.

Maya (CS): Draft update for customers (short):
```
Hi — we wanted to let you know of a brief performance incident today (08:10–08:22 UTC) affecting inference throughput for some onboarding clusters. Root cause: an autoscaler config change that increased instance churn. We rolled back the change and services are stable.

What we did: rollback to previous autoscaler flag, throttled rolling restarts, verified RPC/health checks.

Next steps: Eng will add a safety gate to the autoscaler flag and we’ll issue a post-incident RCA within 48h. We’ll also apply a one-time credit for affected API usage.

If you saw errors, please reply and we’ll follow up 1:1.
```

Sam (AE): Good. Add explicit credit amount? customers like numbers. recommend 5% of last 30 days usage for onboarding tier.

Erin (CS): +1 to including a direct contact line in the note. also recommend asking for any missed deadlines so we can escalate.

Devon (Eng): Action items for RCA:
- add autoscaler safety gate (feature flag enforcement)
- add integration test that simulates transient spot losses and ensures no mass restart
- add metric alert for worker churn > 3% in 5m
I can take ownership, ETA 48h for config change + tests.

Luis (Support): I’ll draft the individual outreach list and attach traces for each affected account. Also logging snippet to include for customers to self-diagnose if they see repeated timeouts:
```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <key>" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/health
# expect 200, check headers: x-rw-latency, x-rw-node-id
```

Maya (CS): OK final note ready, including credit language: "a one-time credit equal to 5% of your usage over the past 30 days will be applied automatically". Adding contact: cs+onboard@redwood.ai. I’ll send the broadcast in 15 min unless ppl object. :wave:

Devon (Eng): no objections. will post RCA draft here once I have the test results.

IncidentBot: Incident #2026 status changed -> RESOLVED (08:22 UTC).

Sam (AE): FYI I’ll follow up with the two highest-risk accounts to offer a short architecture review to prevent churn.

Maya (CS): thanks team — sending now. will create follow-up thread for the 48h RCA and tag eng and support owners. :thumbsup:
